metadata.title: Synthetic Workflow Execution Dataset
metadata.thesis: PA2534 — Performance Optimization of Agentic Automation

processing_times.justification: Specialist agents process primary task type at 2.5x speed reflecting productivity advantage of specialisation [Wooldridge 2009, Multi-Agent Systems]

scenarios.description: All task types arrive equally — balanced workload baseline
60% execution tasks — primary bottleneck scenario from thesis §1.1
40% high priority tasks — urgent verification deadline
50% planning tasks — early project phase simulation
50% monitoring tasks — active testing phase simulation
Tasks arrive in bursts — sudden workload spikes
Task arrival rate increases over time — growing workload
